name: Active Theory

why: a homepage that returns almost nothing to a plain HTML fetch is a tell in its own right - it means the entire experience is built behind a JS boot sequence, which is the studio's known working method (single-page, client-rendered, canvas-first) rather than a copy-and-paste technique to lift

why: shipping a real fallback image (not a blank screen) for browsers that cannot run the experience is the detail worth copying when a homepage leans this hard on WebGL - it is the difference between a broken page and a graceful one for the fraction of visitors who cannot render the real thing
